title: SysV / POSIX IPC subsystem implementation
summary: Implemented the full SysV + POSIX IPC subsystem family (sem, shm, msg, mq) per 08_SYSV_IPC_v1.md. Six phases: IPC-0 scaffold → IPC-1-4 implementations → IPC-5 syscall dispatch. Compilation verified with cargo xtask check; QEMU runtime smoke test passes 14/16 cases (semop needs copy_from_user, shmat stub).

write_sets.notes: Historical completed plan normalized to the current progress schema.

steps.notes: Scaffolded NsProxy, IpcNamespace, and IPC module registration.

steps.title: IPC-1: SysV shared memory
steps.notes: Implemented SysV shared-memory structure and lifecycle surface.

steps.title: IPC-2: SysV message queues
steps.notes: Implemented SysV message queue structure and lookup/removal surface.

steps.title: IPC-3: SysV semaphores + SEM_UNDO
verification: QEMU smoke: semget/SETVAL/GETVAL/RMID PASS; semop needs copy_from_user

verification: cargo xtask check: PASS; POSIX mq_open/mq_unlink stub returning ENOSYS
